note: Publishing is an ALLOWLIST. Nothing under assets/ is served unless a `publish` glob in some metadata.json names it, so this root file needs no rules — the old list of engine-junk excludes (Unity/, *.unitypackage, *.meta …) is gone because junk no longer has to be enumerated to be kept off the CDN. What ships is derived/: built output from bin/convert.ts plus whatever `publish` pushes in. `exclude` still exists, but only to carve holes out of a `publish` glob.
